transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess things have just been a bit off lately. The things that usually make me feel like myself... they just started feeling flat. Heavy, I guess. Like my photography walks, or... mentoring the kids. Even just keeping a clean calendar. I just... stopped initiating them. So, that's what made me come in.
Do you still enjoy doing those things, like photography and mentoring, when you do them, or has the pleasure gone away?

I don't really know. Like I said... it's just flat now. Even if I do try to go out with my camera or something, it still just feels heavy. I don't really get anything out of it anymore. So I just... don't bother starting.
Do you still feel happy or get any pleasure when good things happen to you?
I'm not really sure. I guess... I haven't really noticed. It's hard to tell right now. Everything just kind of blends together.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I don't know if I'd call it sad. Just... I don't really know. Like I said before, it's mostly just... flat.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess. That's actually... that's why I made the appointment. The things I usually do—like the photography walks, mentoring, even just keeping my schedule organized for work—they just feel... flat. Heavy. I don't really initiate any of it anymore.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I think you just asked me that... um, no. I wouldn't really call it sad. Just... like I said a minute ago, it's mostly just flat. I don't really have another word for it.
Do you feel hopeless?
I don't... I wouldn't say hopeless, really. Just... I don't know. Like I said, everything's just kind of heavy right now.
Do you feel guilty about anything?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't done anything to feel guilty about.
Do you feel like you can't experience pleasure?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. Um... that's actually kind of what made me come in, I think. Just... the things that usually make me feel like myself, they don't really do anything right now. 

Like going on my photography walks, or... mentoring the kids. Even just keeping a clean calendar. It all just started feeling flat. And heavy, like I said. So I just... I stopped initiating any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... it's been a while. Maybe... a year and three months, I think. It started after... well, a family member's health changed. Their behavior, too. I had to step in and take on a lot more of the coordination for them, and... yeah. Since around then.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
Um... no. Not really sad. Just... I don't know. Mostly just flat, like I said.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood most of the time?
Um... no. I don't think so. I wouldn't really call it low. Just... kind of what I already said.
Have you been feeling this way for more than two years?

No... like I said earlier, it hasn't been that long. Just about a year and three months. It started when I had to take on all that extra coordination... after my family member's health and behavior changed.
Do you feel depressed?
No, I... I wouldn't say depressed. Just... flat. Like I mentioned.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or look forward to?

Not really. Um... that's actually what made me come in. The things that usually make me feel like myself... like photography walks, or mentoring the kids. Even just keeping a clean calendar. They all just started feeling... flat. And heavy. I just... stopped initiating them.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt this way?
I'm not sure. I haven't really... counted the days. It just kind of blends together.
Do you feel like you're usually in a depressed mood when you wake up in the morning?
I don't know... I guess so. I just wake up and... it's all just kind of the same.
Do you usually feel worse in the morning?
I don't think so. It doesn't really... change as the day goes on. It's just the same.
Do you think you would enjoy activities if you were to start doing them again?

I don't really know. Probably not. That's... I guess that's what made me come in, actually. The things that usually make me feel like myself... they just started feeling flat. Heavy. 

Like going on photography walks, or mentoring the kids... even just keeping a clean calendar. I just... I stopped initiating them. I don't think forcing it now would feel any different.
Have you experienced significant weight loss or gain since you started feeling this way?
No... not that I've noticed. I don't really weigh myself much, but... my clothes still fit the same. So I guess it hasn't changed.
